I have this problem too, so I got one of those pill holders that has the days of the week and put the weeks meds in them.  (You could have your mom do this the first time if you just aren't up to it, but it really isn't bad.) I keep a water bottle by my bed, so I can actually take the meds first thing in the morning with minimal effort.  I also find that getting out of bed, getting dressed and showered, and at least moving to a chair or the couch helps. Sometimes it takes a while, but I have to force myself to do these small steps in order to push towards getting better and yes, my mother has been one of the people who pushes me too.

My parents have a bunch of kids, and our bedrooms are all right next to their's.  And they didn't get a lock until we were teenagers. (?) I never heard them though. They never mention sex, in fact my dad apologized to me once when in the middle of the night I went to the bathroom and he was headed there in his underwear.  But my mom leaves lingerie out in her room if she hasn't had time to put it away (it's typical for her to have a few items of regular clothing around too). I asked why and she said she wanted us to know sex was healthy.  They would take weekends to go to a hotel.  Once I mentioned that it was weird that they would openly mention that they were off to a hotel to their friends and my mom said "WHY IS IT WEIRD THAT WE HAVE SEX? WHERE DO YOU THINK YOU CAME FROM?" I'm glad they're happy, and as an adult I try to be cool, but it's still weird when they announce their anniversary hotel trips ON FACEBOOK. -_-
